jd.title: Junior Python Developer
jd.raw_text:
Junior Python Developer — TechNova Solutions, Bengaluru

We are hiring a fresher Python developer to build and maintain REST APIs for our SaaS platform.

Responsibilities:
- Build REST APIs using Python and FastAPI or Flask
- Write and optimize SQL queries against PostgreSQL
- Collaborate using Git and participate in code reviews
- Write unit tests with pytest

Required skills: Python, Flask or FastAPI, REST API design, SQL, PostgreSQL, Git, pytest, unit testing.
Nice to have: Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, AWS, Linux.

Eligibility: BCA / B.Tech / B.Sc CS freshers welcome. Strong fundamentals in data structures expected.
